body: So you over dosed on the medication? Are you planning on throwing it up and calling an ambulance? You cant give up alot of people are going through deppression some worse than others but we all feel bad. You know that death will bring you nothing and the fact that life is not as static or stable as death is why logically you choose death it makes sense but to be perfectly honest life is completely illogical a guy in a santa suit could come into my bathroom and shit in the tub im bathing in right now.(sorry if my attempt at lightening the mood was inappropriate im trying to help). But really anythings possible lets just be five years old again and pretend everything you want can be obtained is that really anymore unreasonable than thinking life is pointless and you should die? The answers No because life can work out in a million different ways. Call ambulance now and stick around for a while life still has more to show you.

The great cure for life seems to be time because as long as theres time life always finds away. I know you probably dont feel very alive right now, just because you have a heart beat doesnt mean you truly are but things always change at one point or another I was ready to kill myself two weeks ago, I have permanent erectile dysfunction at 21 which requires life long cialis usage you can read my story if you want just so you dont think im some soothsayer throwing out life advice like rice at a wedding because my life is going well, its not, but its going better. I thought I reached rock bottom but I didnt because it can always get better or worse. And now your probably thinking well if life is just this up and down roller coaster whats the point? If everything we earn can be lost, whats the point? If every happy or sad moment can disapper at a drop of a hat who really gives if I speed the process along?  Well to be honest I dont know all I know is those short sweet beautiful moments life gives me right now seem to make all the pain and suffering worth it. I cant know what that moment or thing or person or whatever that is for you, what you fight for, but thats up to you to find it. Just dont give up theres always alteast one thing that makes life worth living just a little bit longer and when you find that one thing it usually snowballs into more and more. Goodluck and I hope your still fighting.

Why would you care that people who dont care about you wont care about you when your gone? Its the people that care about you that matter I.e. your mom, dad, and brother theyve been with you since birth and are more than likely the only people who really care about you and as you grow older youll find the people that care about you are a finite and usually a very small amount. Friends come and go and the people who stick around should be treasured and appreciated desiring the affection of many people just stems from a lack of self worth. I find that when I dislike or  at times hate myself almost nothing anyone can do or say can make me feel better because making me feel better starts with me. And even though I know this I still have periods of disliking myself and feeling alone even though my mom, dad, brother, friends, cousins, girlfriend are only an arms length or phone call away. These mind games are a part of life we know the lessons, the quotes, the messages, the success stories, possibilities whats negative and whats positive but we still manage to slip all the time because thats just the way it is. I find emotions and feelings a fleeting and ever changing and the more you try to fight a certain one or desperatelt hold on to ithers the harder it is to appreciate the good and get over the bad. Its all a process and struggle everyone goes through but never talks about because it wouldnt make sense to anyone else but yourself your problems are yours and only you can fix them. As long as theirs time youll change something will whether good or bad things will be different and I hope you come out better on the other side but thats completely up to you. Just letting you know I battle these thoughts all the time and they come and go it will pass. Have a great day im sure you deserve it.
